        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
import re
def grab(key):
    m=re.search(key+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
    h,w=int(m[1]),int(m[2])
    return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
di,do_,ti=grab('Demo pair 1 input'),grab('Demo pair 1 output'),grab('Test input')
def transform(g):
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if any(r[j] for r in g)]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    sub=[g[i][c0:c1+1] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    return [r[:(len(sub[0])+1)//2] for r in sub[:(len(sub)+1)//2]]
print(transform(di)==do_)
print(transform(ti))
